### Remediation Plan

#### Fixing Memory Safety Issues (CWE-787)
*Current Issue:* Unchecked buffer usage leads to buffer overflows.
```c
char buf[BUFSIZE];
strcpy(buf, input); // Unsafe operation; may cause buffer overflow
```
*Suggested Remedy:* Implement bounds-checking using safer string-copying routines.
```c
snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "%s", input);
```

#### Preventing SQL Injections (CWE-89)
*Current Issue:* Direct embedding of raw query parameters into database queries exposes them to injection attacks.
```sql
query = sprintf("SELECT * FROM users WHERE name='%s'", username);
```
*Suggested Remedy:* Employ parameterized queries or prepared statements.
```python
cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM users WHERE name=?", (username,))
```

#### Securing Authentication Mechanisms (CWE-287)
*Current Issue:* Certain authentication checks are absent or insufficiently implemented.
```cpp
if (!authCheck()) {
   processRequest(); // This should never happen without validation!
}
```
*Suggested Remedy:* Ensure all critical processes require explicit authentication before proceeding.
```cpp
if (authCheck() && hasPrivilege()) {
    processRequest();
} else {
    denyAccess();
}
```
